source_review: The nine-line functional delta consumes the existing admitted model.node_types of each contextual expression and widens only exact Python int values to float.
Promotion happens before the enclosing operation consumes its operand; float overflow and non-finite values produce unknown without partial evidence.
The lexical frame owner, transitive whole-body purity checks, source-bound call identity, argument/default checks and shared work/depth/cache limits are unchanged.
Original 94-test file and constant_functions helper remain raw-byte identical. No preexisting test expectations or catalog/RC5 definitions are edited.
Explicit int casts, v5 integer division for actual integer operands, nonconst floor exclusion, tagged cache identity and old-version controls pass the combined original/revised tests.

open_finding.title: New UDF constant admission applies Python comparisons instead of Pine v6 nine-decimal float comparison rules
open_finding.authority_rule: The v6 documentation requires comparison operators to round floating operands to nine fractional digits. Literal examples avoid halfway ties, so their manual expectations do not depend on an unresolved tie rule.
open_finding.scope: Confirmed v6 only. No v5 backport is asserted from modern documentation.
open_finding.lineage: Baseline without UDF4 rejects static metadata. Both original UDF4 and corrected UDF5 newly compile six incorrect boolean defaults. This is separate from the corrected int-to-float promotion defect.
open_finding.suggested_owner_action: Use a reviewed version-exact comparison rule through the existing producer numeric owner, or withhold constant evidence for the unreviewed floating comparison surface. Preserve integer and ordinary controls and original failure evidence.
